4 أَسْرَجْتُ السِّرَاجَ (O, Msb, TA) I lighted the lamp, or wick. (Msb, TA.) ―
-b2- [And اسرج signifies also He lighted himself or another with a lamp &c.; and so ↓ استسرج : or each of these, with بِهِ following it, he employed it (i. e. a lamp, or oil, &c.,) as a means of light: see اِصْطَبَحَ, in art. صبح.] ＝
-A2- أَسْرَجْتُ الدَّابَّةَ, (S, K, *) or الفَرَسَ, (Msb,) I bound the saddle, or his saddle, upon the beast, or horse: (Msb, K:) or I made a saddle for the [beast, or] horse. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
